protocol.comparison: offline old/new repair on identical saved pre-repair nm coordinates; require exact candidate replay of the actual in-process result
protocol.enrollment: ALL six named real tracked inputs x two requested FF routes, H seed1, exactly one prep each; no outcome-dependent replacement or retry
protocol.ff_coverage: record actual XMLs and forcefield-free fallback, not just requested FF; CHARMM naming via GLYCAM bridge is NOT native CHARMM glycan sampling

protocol.observation: native H boundaries and actual production repair before/after, exact nm positions and RNG state; no native reporter or energy/force query
protocol.readiness: any unexpected matched replay, valid-H/heavy/identity movement or unjustified new refusal blocks qualification; every refusal and upstream blocker remains visible
protocol.validation: same-residue OH contract, immutable heavy/valid H/bonds/identity, independent short-OH and cross-residue contacts as warnings, DatRecord load and actual output status
